description.value: Little Caesars is a well-known Canadian pizza chain franchise offering ready-made and made-to-order pizzas for pickup or delivery. This Fraser Street location serves the southeast Vancouver neighbourhood and is a convenient hot-food stop for cyclists on a budget. The chain is known for its Hot-N-Ready model and Detroit-style deep dish options.
